    function retry() {
      fallbackAttempts++;
      console.log('[Cookiebot] Fallback attempt ' + fallbackAttempts + '/' + MAX_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS);

      const shown = showCookiebotIfNeeded();
      if (shown) {
        console.log('[Cookiebot] Fallback succeeded, banner shown');
        return;
      }

      if (fallbackAttempts >= MAX_FALLBACK_ATTEMPTS) {
        logBannerFailure();
        return;
      }

      fallbackTimeoutId = setTimeout(retry, FALLBACK_INTERVAL);
    }

    retry();
  }

    if (isObserving) return;
    isObserving = true;
